div.div: 4 ابلعهُ الشَّىْءَ (S, K, * TA) He made him to swallow the thing: (S, TA:) or he enabled him to swallow the thing. (K, * TA.) You say, أَبْلِعْنِى رِيقِى [Suffer thou me to swallow my spittle;] give thou me time to swallow my spittle. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
